title: Datazag Threat Intelligence
descriptionMarkdown:
Datazag detects brand impersonation, platform impersonation and attacker infrastructure from Certificate Transparency at certificate issuance time, scores each finding, and publishes high-confidence results as STIX 2.1 indicators over a TAXII 2.1 server.

Indicators are ingested using Microsoft Sentinel's built-in **Threat Intelligence - TAXII** data connector and land in the native **ThreatIntelIndicators** table. No custom table, data collection rule or workspace function is required. Indicators are available to analytics rules and hunting queries immediately, and because they are retained in the workspace you can retro-hunt existing logs against them.

Datazag never queries your workspace. Delivery is pull-only: Sentinel polls the Datazag TAXII server on a schedule you control.

**Collections**

| Collection | Contents |
|---|---|
| `platform-alerts` | Domains impersonating widely-used platforms |
| `Infrastructure-alerts` | Hosting infrastructure associated with confirmed impersonation campaigns |

Each collection is configured as a separate TAXII server entry.
additionalRequirementBanner: Analytic rules and hunting queries in this solution query DNS activity through the [Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/normalization). The ASIM DNS parsers must be deployed in this workspace, and the workspace must be receiving DNS telemetry, for this content to return results.

sampleQueries.description: Active Datazag indicators, latest revision of each
sampleQueries.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where tostring(Data.created_by_ref) == 'identity--55a5a448-c6f1-5128-bc71-4d85b719131e'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where IsDeleted == false and tostring(Data.revoked) != 'true'
| where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
| project TimeGenerated, ObservableValue, Confidence, ValidUntil, Evidence = tostring(Data.labels)

sampleQueries.description: Datazag indicator volume by collection over the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where tostring(Data.created_by_ref) == 'identity--55a5a448-c6f1-5128-bc71-4d85b719131e'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| summarize Indicators = dcount(Id) by SourceSystem, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Obtain your Datazag TAXII credentials
instructionSteps.description:
Datazag issues a username and password unique to your organisation. Contact Datazag to request them, quoting the collections your subscription includes.

The API root is the same for all subscribers:

instructionSteps.title: 2. Add the platform impersonation collection
instructionSteps.description:
In the Microsoft Defender portal, go to **Microsoft Sentinel** > **Configuration** > **Data connectors**, open **Threat Intelligence - TAXII**, and select **Open connector page**. Then select **Add** and enter:

- **Friendly name** -  a label of your choosing. Note that this value becomes the `SourceSystem` for indicators from this collection.
- **API root URL** -  as above.
- **Collection ID** -  below.
- **Username** and **Password** -  issued by Datazag.
- **Polling frequency** -  once an hour is recommended.

Select **Add** to save.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Add the attacker infrastructure collection
instructionSteps.description:
Repeat step 2 with the collection ID below, using a different friendly name. Each collection is a separate TAXII server entry.

Skip this step if your subscription does not include the infrastructure feed.

instructionSteps.title: 4. Confirm indicators are arriving
instructionSteps.description:
The first poll runs within your chosen polling interval. Once indicators arrive, the status above changes to **Connected**, and they appear under **Microsoft Sentinel** > **Threat management** > **Intel management**.

To verify directly, run this in **Advanced hunting**:

```
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where tostring(Data.created_by_ref) == "identity--55a5a448-c6f1-5128-bc71-4d85b719131e"
| summarize Indicators = dcount(Id), Latest = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceSystem
```

If nothing arrives within two polling intervals, re-check the collection ID and credentials. Note that content in this solution identifies Datazag indicators by `Data.created_by_ref` rather than by `SourceSystem`, because `SourceSystem` reflects the friendly name you chose in step 2.
